name: Arcticons
about: Arcticons is a free, open-source icon set with 15,709 icons designed by Donnnno. From navigation and actions to files, media and communication, it covers everyday UI needs. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0.

faqs.a: Yes. All 15,709 Arcticons are open source under the CC BY-SA 4.0 license – free to download, customize and use. Always check the CC BY-SA 4.0 terms for attribution or commercial-use requirements.

faqs.q: How do I use Arcticons in React or my website?
faqs.a: Copy any icon as a React / TypeScript component straight into your project, or paste the CDN link into your HTML. Every icon also downloads as SVG, PNG or WebP, and you can recolor and resize it in the browser before you export.
There are 15,709 icons in the Arcticons set, designed by Donnnno. Use the search above to find any icon by name.

faqs.q: Can I change the color and size of Arcticons?
faqs.a: Yes. Open any icon, pick a size and color, and the preview updates instantly. SVG, PNG and WebP exports follow your choices, and React snippets recolor through props.

faqs.q: What formats are Arcticons available in?
faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
